_comment: Phase 9 contextual-fit expansion (public terms only — Snyk/CRAN/Redis/k8s). For each term: 5 term-intended (cNN-<term>) and 5 common-word-intended (oNN-<term>-<commonword>) utterances, all distinct sentences. Term sentences evoke the term's domain; common sentences use a genuine near-homophone in an ordinary, non-technical context (so they should NOT match the term's blurb). Recorded by the maintainer (git-ignored audio); used by analyze_contextual_fit.py. Blurbs were frozen before these sentences were written. IDs start at 20 to avoid colliding with the existing c01-16/o01-18 human clips.
